title: Which Dots Are Exactly 5 Apart? | AMC 8-Style Level 4
description:
25 dots in a grid, and the question sounds easy: how many pairs are exactly 5 units apart? Two sneaky traps are hiding in this one. Vantee shows two ways to count the pairs, explains why every wrong answer is tempting, then gives you a bigger grid to try yourself.
